neighbours.label: a noun naming a connected set of many things: series, network, system, archipelago
fire: The publisher launched a new workbook series for primary teachers.
A dense rail network connects the northern towns.
The ferry stops at every island in the archipelago.
Engineers upgraded the city's drainage system last summer.
She watched the whole series in one weekend.
The bank runs a network of branches across the country.
Explorers mapped the remote archipelago in 1820.
The island has a reliable bus system linking every village.
quiet: The publisher launched a new workbook for primary teachers.
A new rail line connects the northern towns.
The ferry stops at every harbour on the coast.
Engineers repaired the city's main bridge last summer.
She watched the whole film in one evening.
The bank opened a branch in the capital.
Explorers mapped the remote island in 1820.
The island has a reliable bus that links the villages.

notes: Card: top tokens ' series', ' Series', 'ipel' (archipelago), ' network', ' system', plus ' of' after such nouns. The shared pattern is a noun for one whole made of many linked parts.
